title: Neules (Catalan Wafers)
description: A simple, crispy sweet that is a Christmas table must-have: rolled neules wafers made on the classic iron.

instructions.title: Whisk the eggs
instructions.description: Whisk the eggs with the sugar until pale and fluffy.

instructions.title: Make the batter
instructions.description: Add the flour, melted butter, lemon zest and orange blossom water; mix until you get a smooth batter.

instructions.title: Cook on the iron
instructions.description: Heat the neula iron and spoon in a small amount of batter each time, spreading it thin.

instructions.title: Roll them up
instructions.description: Cook until light golden, taking care not to burn them, and roll each neula up immediately while hot using a thin stick.

instructions.title: Let them cool
instructions.description: Let them cool on a wire rack before serving.
